label: sec:mesons-nucleons-categorical-proton-unique-preamble
html: Within the three-strand Borromean link topology, the orientation of the internal trefoil twist distinguishes the two nucleon isospin states. This section proves the uniqueness of the categorical proton and categorical neutron in H_3(q), constructs the meson-to-proton Borromean lifting morphism, and demonstrates that crossing reversal \sigma_i \leftrightarrow \sigma_i^{-1} maps particles to antiparticles while exchanging left- and right-handed trefoil chirality between the electron and positron.
